title: Когда действие направлено на нас
description: Когда действие направлено на нас: применяем правило в самостоятельных ситуациях, работаем со словарём и читаем авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Отличать выполнение действия от получения действия
notes: После предлога возможен пассивный герундий: without being informed.
Being criticised означает подвергаться критике; criticising означает критиковать самому.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: They objected to ___ from the discussion.
exercises.explanation: После to как предлога в objected to нужен пассивный герундий being excluded.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение словом из пары: informing / informed.

public_payload.sentence: The schedule changed without anyone being ___.

exercises.editorial_answer: The schedule changed without anyone being informed.
exercises.explanation: Людей уведомляют, поэтому пассивное being informed.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Ей не нравилось, когда её прерывали во время объяснения.»
exercises.editorial_answer: She disliked being interrupted during the explanation.
exercises.explanation: Being interrupted указывает, что прерывают её, а не она сама прерывает других.

exercises.prompt: Исправь указанную конструкцию, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: He complained about being ignore during the meeting.

accepted: He complained about being ignored during the meeting.

exercises.reference_answer: He complained about being ignored during the meeting.
exercises.incorrect_answer: He complained about being ignore during the meeting.
exercises.editorial_answer: He complained about being ignored during the meeting.
exercises.explanation: В пассивном герундии после being требуется причастие ignored.

exercises.prompt: Почему группа могла не узнать о встрече?

public_payload.passage: A neighbourhood group complained about being excluded from a planning discussion. The organiser replied that the meeting had been advertised online. However, several regular participants used a printed noticeboard rather than the website, and no notice had been placed there. The group did not demand that every decision be reversed immediately. It asked for a chance to comment before the final recommendation was submitted. The disagreement concerned meaningful participation, not merely whether a notice technically existed somewhere.

options.label: Some members relied on a noticeboard that had no announcement.
The organiser had never advertised it anywhere.
Every member had already read the online notice.

exercises.editorial_answer: Some members relied on a noticeboard that had no announcement.
exercises.explanation: Онлайн-объявление существовало, но привычный канал части участников не использовался.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова урока с переводом в указанном контексте.
exercises.editorial_answer: inform — уведомлять; consult — советоваться; exclude — исключать; notice — уведомление
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: inform — уведомлять; consult — советоваться; exclude — исключать; notice — уведомление.

public_payload.passage: A neighbourhood group complained about being excluded from a planning discussion. The organiser replied that the meeting had been advertised online. However, several regular participants used a printed noticeboard rather than the website, and no notice had been placed there. The group did not demand that every decision be reversed immediately. It asked for a chance to comment before the final recommendation was submitted. The disagreement concerned meaningful participation, not merely whether a notice technically existed somewhere.

options.label: Immediate reversal of every decision without discussion.
A permanent end to all online announcements.
An opportunity to comment before the final recommendation.

exercises.editorial_answer: An opportunity to comment before the final recommendation.
exercises.explanation: Просьба касается участия до окончательной рекомендации, а не немедленной отмены всего.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Did they tell you about the changed venue?

options.label: No. I arrived without being informed of the change.
No. I arrived without being inform of the change.
No. I arrived without be informed of the change.

exercises.editorial_answer: No. I arrived without being informed of the change.
exercises.explanation: Without being informed — пассивный герундий после without.

public_payload.sentence: To leave someone out of a discussion is to ___ them.

exercises.explanation: Exclude — исключить из участия, в отличие от совета или уведомления.
